fact_text: A fakeout is when price breaks above a level but cannot hold above it and trades back below the level, trapping buyers who entered on the breakout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '16. What is a Fakeout? | Master Technical Analysis & Fakeouts in the Pakistan Stock Market (PSX)' (YouTube, 2024-11-08)

fact_text: A breakout without a heavy-volume candle is more likely to be a fakeout, which is usually confirmed when price falls back below the broken level within a day or an hour on heavy selling.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '16. What is a Fakeout? | Master Technical Analysis & Fakeouts in the Pakistan Stock Market (PSX)' (YouTube, 2024-11-08)

fact_text: A genuine breakout is confirmed when price closes above the broken level for a day or two and then moves higher; the analyst advises waiting for this before acting.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '16. What is a Fakeout? | Master Technical Analysis & Fakeouts in the Pakistan Stock Market (PSX)' (YouTube, 2024-11-08)

fact_text: The analyst says trades should be taken only on a confirmed breakout, not on the first move above a level, to avoid being caught in a fakeout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '16. What is a Fakeout? | Master Technical Analysis & Fakeouts in the Pakistan Stock Market (PSX)' (YouTube, 2024-11-08)

fact_text: On 8 Nov 2024 the analyst said Flying Cement was retesting a strong resistance it had broken on the daily chart, with heavy selling visible at that level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '16. What is a Fakeout? | Master Technical Analysis & Fakeouts in the Pakistan Stock Market (PSX)' (YouTube, 2024-11-08)

fact_text: On the weekly chart, Flying Cement had been rejected several times at the same strong resistance, which the analyst treats as a long-standing barrier.
